description: Browse AppScreenshoot's published App Store and Google Play screenshot templates. Filter by category, visual style, free tier, or a keyword. Returns the template slug, name, colors, first preview image, and links to its detail page and editor.

category.description: Exact category, for example Beauty, Fitness, Finance, or Travel.

free.description: When true, only return templates available on the free tier.

limit.description: Maximum templates to return. Defaults to 12, capped at 50.

query.description: Keyword to match against each template's name, category, style, or description.

style.description: Partial style match, for example Editorial, Airy, Violet, or Bold.

name: list_templates
title: List app screenshot templates
